entities.summary: Politehnica University of Timișoara is a public university in Timișoara. The 10 faculties of the university provide study programs for about 13,000 students. In 2011, Politehnica University of Timișoara was classified as an advanced research and education university by the Ministry of Education. The university is a founding member of the Romanian Alliance of Technical Universities (ARUT). Politehnica University of Timișoara is a university in Europe, established in 1920.
